`interface EventListener<E extends Event>`<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.ui.event` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [EventListener.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/ui/event/EventListener.java)

A function that JOID calls with an event, written as a lambda, with a priority that orders it among the other listeners.

## Description

Every `onX`, `beforeX` and `handleX` method of JOID takes one.
A lambda has the priority [`EventPriority.NORMAL`](/reference/events/eventpriority/#EventPriority-value-NORMAL); wrap it with `priority(...)` to give it another one.

- [Events](/use/learn/interactivity/events/#order-the-listeners-of-one-event)
